correctness.rationale: The polynomial factors as one smooth conic K and five distinct lines. K is the unique nonlinear component and x=0 the unique secant among the lines (restriction y^2-z^2 versus squares on the other four). The secant marks the two tangency points y=±z. On parametrization [2t:1-t²:1+t²], any preserving Möbius map fixes {0,∞} and {1,-1} setwise; it must be t,−t,1/t,−1/t. The conic action is faithful for projective PGL3, and all four maps arise from independent sign flips x,y. Thus precisely C2×C2. Independent symbolic checks verified conic restrictions, parametrization and diagonal maps.
